instruction: Ọka m (maize) na-adị ka ọ di iche iche.
response: Enwere ike inwe ihe kpatara ya. Iji nyere m aka ịmata nsogbu ahụ kpọmkwem, ọ na-agbanwe agba site n'akwụkwọ ndị dị n'okpuru ma ọ bụ n'ọhụrụ ndị dị n'elu? Ọzọkwa, ọ dị nnukwu mmiri ozuzo zokwara n'oge na-adịbeghị anya na mpaghara gị?

instruction: Biko ewu m na-akwara ụkwara site ụnyaahụ.
response: Ka anyị kpokọta obere ozi tupu anyị nwee ike inyere ewu gị aka. Ihe dị ka anụmanụ ole na-enwe nsogbu a, na ha ka na-eri nri nke ọma? Ịmata afọ ojuju ha na ụdị ha (breed) ga-enyekwara m aka inye gị ndụmọdụ ziri ezi.

instruction: Kedu fatịlaịza (fertilizer) m kwesịrị iji?
response: Tupu m akwado ihe ọ bụla, achọrọ m ịmatakwu banyere ugbo gị. Kedu ihe ọkụkụ na ụdị (variety) gị, gịnịkwa bụ ogo uto ya ugbu a? Ọ bụrụkwa na ị maara ụdị ala gị ma ọ bụ akụkọ nri fatịlaịza gị mbụ, nke ahụ ga-enye aka nke ukwuu.

instruction: Ọkụkọ m kwụsịrị iri nri.
response: Enwere ọtụtụ ihe nwere ike ibute ọdịda na mberede na iri nri ha. Kedu afọ ole igwe ọkụkọ ahụ dị, na kedu nri ị na-eji ugbu a? Ọzọkwa, biko mee ka m mara ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụta mgbaàmà ọ bụla ọzọ dị ka nku dara ada (drooping wings), afọ ọsịsa (diarrhea), ma ọ bụ iku ume ọhụrụ.

instruction: Enwere m ọka hybrid nke izu atọ na Zaria na ala loamy. Ejiri m NPK 20:10:10 mgbe m na-akụ ya. Kedu usoro nri ajị (fertilizer schedule) na ọnụego kwa hekta (rate per hectare) akwadoro maka ibuli ya n'elu (top-dressing)?
response: Ebe ọka gị dị izu atọ na ị jirila NPK 20:10:10 dị ka nri ntọala (basal dose), nzọụkwụ na-esote bụ top-dressing na Urea (46% N) n'etiti izu 4 ruo 5 mgbe a kụchara ya. Tinye na ọnụego ihe dịka 100 ruo 120 kg kwa hekta (ihe dị ka akpa 2 ruo 2.5) site na itinye ya n'akụkụ ma ọ bụ ili ya 5-10 cm pụọ n'okpuru osisi iji gbochie mfu njikwa oge (volatilization loss).

instruction: Akwụkwọ ahụ na-atụgharị na-acha odo odo (purple).
response: Nkọwa ole na ole ga-enyere m aka ịmata ụkọ nri ahụ ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara nsogbu ahụ. Kedu ihe ọkụkụ bụ nke a, ọ bụ naanị ụmụ osisi (young plants) ka emetụtara? Ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ekwe omume, biko bugo foto (upload a clear photo) doro anya nke osisi ahụ dum yana anya nke ebe ahụ metụtara na akwụkwọ ya.

instruction: Ehi m fụrụ afụ (swollen).
response: Ọ ga-amasị m ịghọta ọnọdụ ahụ nke ọma n'ihi na ọzịza nwere ike igosi ọnọdụ dị iche iche. Ebee kpọmkwem ka ọzịza ahụ dị—ọ dị n'agba, akụkụ aka ekpe nke afọ, ụkwụ, ma ọ bụ ara? Ọzọkwa, kedu ogologo oge ọ nọworo n'ebe ahụ, na ọ na-eri ahịhịa nke ọma?

instruction: Gịnị kpatara okooko osisi tomato m (tomato blossoms) ji adapụ tupu ha ebido mkpụrụ?
response: Iji belata nke a, ènwere mgbanwe ọkụ na mpaghara gị n'oge na-adịbeghị anya, ọkachasị maka ụbọchị na-ekpo ọkụ ma ọ bụ abalị na-ekpo ọkụ? Ọ ga-amasị m ịmata ma a na-eji mmiri a na-agba mmiri na-agba mmiri mgbe niile yana ma ị jirila fatịlaịza nwere nitrogen dị elu n'oge na-adịbeghị anya.

instruction: Agbasara m ugbo kabeji m ọgwụ ụbọchị 3 gara aga mana ụkpara (caterpillars) ka na-emebi ha.
response: Ka anyị lelee nkọwa iji mara usoro ziri ezi tupu ikpebi na nzọụkwụ ọzọ. Kedu ụdị ọgwụ pesticide kapịrị ọnụ ma ọ bụ ihe na-arụsi ọrụ ike i jiri, nakwa gịnị bụ oge etinyere ya? Ọzọkwa, ihe mgbaàmà a ọ na-akawanye njọ na akwụkwọ ọhụrụ ahụ?

instruction: Ji akpụ m anaghị eto nke ọma.
response: Tupu inye ndụmọdụ, achọrọ m ntakịrị nkọwa banyere ogige gị. Kedu ụdị ọkụkụ ị na-eto, na ole mgbe a kụrụ ya? Ọ ga-enye aka ịmata ma ọ bụrụ na a na-akọ ala mgbe nile n'enweghị oge ezumike (fallow period) ma ọ bụ itinyekwu ihe ajị.

instruction: Achọrọ m enyemaka.
response: Ndewo! Abụ m Homa, onye inyeaka gị n'ịkọ ugbo site na Fallback AI. Iji bido, ị nwere ike ime ka m mara ma gị na ihe ubi ma ọ bụ anụ ụlọ na-arụ ọrụ taa, yana gịnị bụ ihe ịma aka a kapịrị ọnụ ị na-achọ idozi?

instruction: Ụfọdụ ose na-anwụ.
response: Nke a nwere ike ibute site na fungal root rot, bacterial wilt, ma ọ bụ nsogbu ịgba mmiri. Nke a ọ na-eme n'ụlọ nkwakọba ihe gị ma ọ bụ isi ebe ị na-arụ ọrụ (main field)? Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike ibugo ọtụtụ foto na-egosi osisi dum, ọnọdụ akwụkwọ, yana ahụ osisi kpọmkwem na njedebe nke ala, nke ahụ ga-enyere m aka nyochaa ya nke ọma.

instruction: Gịnị bụ ogo ọkụ ụlọ ọkụkọ (standard brooding temperature) kwesịrị ekwesị maka ụmụ ọkụkọ broiler nwere ụbọchị mbụ n'ime izu mbụ ha na ụlọ ahịhịa miri emi (deep litter house)?
response: Maka ụmụ ọkụkọ broiler nke ụbọchị otu, biko nọgide na okpomọkụ ebe izu na-ada (brooding temperature) n'etiti 32°C na 33°C (90°F ruo 92°F) na ọkwa anụ ọhịa. Nyochaa àgwà ụmụ ọkụkọ nke ọma: ọ bụrụ na ha agbakọta ọnụ n'okpuru ọkụ, oyi na-atụ ya; ọ bụrụ na ha asọpụrụ gaa n'akụkụ pụọ na okpomọkụ ma na-eku ume ngwa ngwa, okpomọkụ dị n'elu ukwuu. Wedata okpomọkụ site na 2°C kwa izu ọzọ ruo mgbe enwetara okpomọkụ ime ụlọ.

instruction: M kwesịrị ịkụ ọka sorghum m ugbu a?
response: Iji nye gị ihu igwe ziri ezi na ntụziaka akuku, kedu steeti na ime ọchịchị (Local Government Area) ị nọ? Achọrọ m ịma ụdị sorghum (variety) ị chọrọ ịkụ, ebe oge uto ma chọọkwa mmiri na-adị iche iche.

instruction: Ebee ka m ga-enweta ezigbo ọnụ ahịa ere soyabeans m kọrọ akọ?
response: Iji nye ndụmọdụ ezigbo ahịa (realistic market advisory) maka mpaghara gị, steeti ma ọ bụ mpaghara kedu ka ị na-ere ugbu a? Biko kọwaakwa oke ngwa (approximate volume) ị nwere (na akpa ma ọ bụ tọn metric) yana ma ekwadoro mkpụrụ ahụ ka ọ kpọọ nkụ ma dị ọcha.

instruction: Kedu ihe kpatara mmepụta àkwá na-adagharị n'ime cage m (layers cage)?
response: Enwere ike inwe ọtụtụ ihe nwere ike ibute ọdịda mberede nke àkwá ịmụ. Kedu izu ole ụmụ ọkụkọ ndị ahu dị, na ị gbanweela ụdị nri ha (feed brand) ma ọ bụ usoro (formulation) n'oge na-adịbeghị anya? Ọzọkwa, biko lelee ma enwere nsogbu nkwụsị n'inye mmiri ọ bụla kwa ụbọchị.

instruction: Ọ dị na Benue, ha dị ugbu a izu 4.
response: Daalụ maka ọnọdụ na nkọwa afọ ndụ gị. Iji nye gị ndụmọdụ ziri ezi maka ugbo gị dị izu 4 na Benue, kedu ihe ọkụkụ ma ọ bụ ụdị anụ ụlọ ka anyị na-atụle, na kedu ihe mgbaàmà kapịrị ọnụ ma ọ bụ nsogbu uto ị hụworo?

instruction: Ezi abụọ nwụrụ n'ụtụtụ a na mberede na-enweghị ọrịa ọ bụla.
response: Nke a bụ ọnọdụ siri ike nke na-achọ nlebara anya ngwa ngwa. Kedu afọ ole ezì (pigs) ndị ahụ dị, gịnịkwa ma ị chọpụta mmiri ma ọ bụ obara uhie ma ọ bụ odo-odo dị n'akụkụ ntị, afọ, ma ọ bụ akpụkpọ ha tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe ha nwụsịrị? Biko kọwaakwa ma enwere ngosipụta nri ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ndị ọbịa na ahịhịa n'oge na-adịbeghị anya.

instruction: Ụmụ kọkọ (cocoa seedlings) m na-agbanwe ụcha odo n'akụkụ ha.
response: Ka anyị lelee gburugburu ọnọdụ ebe ịchụ irugbin gị (nursery). Kedu nnukwu ndò (shade) ndị osisi ndị ahụ na-enweta ugbu a, na ọwa mmiri ahụ (drainage) n'ime nwa rọba polybag ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma ka a gbasịrị mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo buru ibu? Ịmata ụdị njikọta nke ala (soil mixture) ị na-eji ga-enyekwara aka.

instruction: Achọrọ m ibido mee ka ehi ibu ibu (cattle fattening), kedu nri kacha mma?
response: Nri a kwadoro maka ibuli ahụ anụmanụ (fattening diet) na-adabere nke ukwuu n'ụdị ehi (cattle breed) na nbata ịdị arọ gị ị na-elekwasị anya. Ọzọkwa, gwa m kedu ihe oriri sitere n'ụlọ ọrụ ọrụ ugbo (agro-industrial by-products)—dị ka wheat offal, brewers' dried grain, ma ọ bụ palm kernel cake—dị mfe inweta na mpaghara gị.

instruction: Mmiri na-ekpuchi ogige osikapa m ruo abalị 4 mgbe nnukwu mmiri ozuzo zosịrị.
response: Iji mara usoro maka nnapụta (potential recovery) nke osikapa gị, kedu n'ime uto (growth stage) ya ka ọ dị mgbe idei mmiri mere? Biko kọọrọ m ma mbido osisi n'ụlọ ahụ ma ka na-apụta karịa mmiri, na ole ụbọchị maka ogige mmiri ịgbadakarị.

instruction: Ahịhịa ọjọọ (weeds) na-eweghara ogige ahụekere (groundnut) m.
response: Ka anyị kpokọta obere ozi ngwa iji kpebie ezigbo nhọrọ ịbelata ahịhịa n'enweghị mmerụ ahụ (weed control method). Ọ bụ izu ole gara aga ka ị kụrụ ahụekere, jikwa mmiri gwọrọ mmiri (pre-emergence herbicide) ọ bụla eme n'oge a kụrụ? Ọzọkwa, kedu ahịhịa ndụ pụtarachara n'ike nke kacha pụta n'okpuru osisi ma ọ bụ broadleaf?

instruction: Mmiri ole na lita (liters of water) ehi (lactating dairy cattle) chọrọ ka mmiri ara ara maka ogologo otu ụbọchị n'oge oyi pụrụ iche (tropical climate)?
response: N'ebe mmiri ọkụ dị (tropical climate), ehi nọ n'ụbara ara chọrọ mmiri nke fọrọ site 60 ruo 100+ lita dị ọcha (clean, fresh water) kwa ụbọchị, dabere n'ụba ngwa mmiri (milk yield), nri eweere n'ihu (dry matter intake), na ogo okpomọkụ (ambient temperature). Mmadụ ehi chọrọ ka ike imepụta n'ọnọdụ ahụ dị njọ pụta nke ihu ígwé mkpọrọ okpomọkụ, chọrọ ntụkwasị anya kacha ehi maka oge niile (ad-libitum - 24/7) n'ime ebe kwụsị ndò.

instruction: Ihe ọcha nwere ájá (powdery stuff) na akwụkwọ cucumber m.
response: Nke a na-ada dị ka ọrịa powdery mildew, mana ka anyị kwenye tupu ịhọrọ ọgwụgwọ (treatment). Ọtụtụ ntụpọ ọcha ọ na-apụta n'elu nakwa n'okpuru akwụkwọ ahụ, kedu oge mbụ ị chọpụtara nke a? Ọzọkwa, a kụrụ ihe ọkụkụ a n'ubi kpụkọtara akpụkọ (open field) ka ọ dị n'ime ụlọ akwụkwọ echekwa oyi (greenhouse)?

instruction: Biko ewe okra m (okra leaves) na-enwe ọtụtụ oghere.
response: Achọrọ m ịghọta ọnọdụ ahụ n'ụzọ ka mma ka anyị wee kwụsị mmebi akwụkwọ (leaf damage). Ị̀ lere anya na mpaghara okpuru (underside) akwụkwọ na ụtụtụ echi (early morning) maka ahụhụ ukwu ma ọ bụ ùkpè (beetles or caterpillars)? Ọzọkwa, gwa m ma osisi ahụ ebidola isite okooko (flowering) ka anyị chọọ ụdị njikwa kòkòrò na-agaghị emerụ kòkòrò amara uru (beneficial pollinators).

instruction: Azụ catfish m na-ese n'elu mmiri jupụtara na apịtị (pond) ma na-asọ nweta ume (gasping for air).
response: Iji nyere gị aka chọpụta ihe kpatara nsogbu ahụ, kedu ụdị apịtị (type of pond) ị na-eji — nke ikpo aja (earthen), ihe siri ike ka ngwongwo awara awara (concrete), ma ọ bụ ihe roba na-egbochi mmiri na tapọlin (tarpaulin)? Ọzọkwa, gwa m mgbe ikpeazụ ị gbanwere mmiri, na ma enwere isi mmiri na-adịghị mma si n'apịtị ahụ.

instruction: Gịnị mere ji (yams) m ji adịrị n'ime ụlọ nkwakọba (storage barn)?
response: Ka anyị lere ọnọdụ nkwakọba (storage conditions) na mgbe mbụ ị gbuteere ya. A rụzuru usoro iwepụ ikuku nke ọma maka ibugharị ebe a na ndò na-enye nsogbu tupu ịchikọta n'ime ụlọ ahụ, na ị na-ahụ ma ndaghari na-enweghị isi nkụ na nrekpa mmetụ ọkụ (dry rot) ka ọ dị njọ ma ọ na-esi isi (soft, smelly rot)? Ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ekwe omume, tinye foto ji nke nwere nsogbu.

instruction: Gịnị bụ nweta ngụkọta nke izu ụmụ ewu nọ n'afọ (average gestation period) nye obere ewu na West Africa (West African Dwarf goat)?
response: Ogologo oge nkezi oge nọ na ọnọdụ (average gestation period) maka ewu West African Dwarf (WAD) ruru izu nwere otu narị nkwado (145 to 152 days), ya bụ na ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọnwa ise. N'aka nkasi ike n'usoro ikiri omumu njikwa (kidding management), ọ dị mkpa ijikere ogige ebe anụ (kidding pen) ga atụ maka nyocha nke ụbọchị ihe fọrọ ka asaa.

instruction: Biko kedu ọgwụ chemical (chemical) m nwere ike fesaa maka ahịhịa (weed) dị n'ugbo egusi m?
response: Tupu anyị ahọrọ ihe ọgwụ igbo (herbicide), achọrọ m ịma ma mkpụrụ osisi egusi na-epulite (germinated) ka ị ka na-akwadebe ala tupu ịkụcha. Ọzọkwa, ụdị ahịhịa ole (types of weeds) na-etokasị n'ebe ahụ—n'aka ha bụrụkwa akwụkwọ osisi broad leaves ka ahịhịa ukwu osisi niile na n'elu (tall grasses)?

instruction: Atụrụ m (sheep) na-arịa ọnya siri ike nke na-emebi ya (diarrhea) na ahụ dị ya ike, ịbụla oke abụ (losing weight) dị egwu.
response: Ihe ahụ pụtara na o nwere ịdị na obere ihe dị iche na njikwa ikike nri na nje na-arịa n'afọ, ike imeju (internal parasites) na nsogbu na nje ụbọchị ozi. Ogologo oge (When) gịnị gbanwere gbasara ọgwụ ime (dewormed) ohere kachasị nso, ka ị bidoro nye ya nri nwe mgbasa obere (new forage or concentrate) ahịhịa?

instruction: Akụrụ m akụkụ ụmụ ọgịrị (plantain suckers) ruo ọnwa 4, mana akwụkwọ ya n'eje maka ihi ucha ụkwụ-edo ma asọpụkwa n'ọnụ.
response: Obere nkọwa ndenye obere obere na-enye ozi izute nsogbu n'ezie site n'aka ịkpata gbòǹgbò ala. Ala na ogige gị ọ na ejigide mmiri hiri nne emechara oke mmiri (retains too much water), yana ibido ọrụ ka i lere ọnọdụ gburugburu osisi iji zere ụbara ahụhụ akpụrụ osisi ukwu ahụ (plantain weevils)?

instruction: Olee ọnwa na-esochi na-adị mma dịka isi mbido (plant) osisi ginger n'oge izu-na steeti Kaduna (Kaduna State)?
response: Iji nyekwuo m nkwado, ka enye gị ihu mmiri nke mbụ nye Kaduna, mmiri ịkọ (irrigation) jikwa usoro mbupu n'obodo ka ị ga-enyocha ya na ugbo? Ozi banyere njikwa gburugburu ebe ụlọ okike obodo LGA na-edobere ngwa, na obodo gọọmenti ọchịchị ukwu site dịka mmiri ji ada ngwa njikwa ngwa.

instruction: Ụmụ toro-toro (turkey poults) m na-anwụchi kwa ụbọchị n'izu ha.
response: Ihe ebe a chọrọ ka akpọọ nkụ ozugbo pụrụ-iche n'ozugbo. Afọ ole dị n'etiti ụmụ gị, na gịnị gbasara izu ụlọ oyi gị (brooding temperature) nye igwe ebe o wara? Biko jiri otu ka enyi mara ma igbọ-mmiri ha mebiri ka mmiri ojii ụgbụ mmiri.

instruction: Akwụkwọ nkwụ-mmanụ m (oil palm seedlings) nwere akara na agba (brown spots) na odo dịka egbugbere eji ọkụ chọọ.
response: Ka anyị jide nyocha ogige ọgbin iji gosi ọnọdụ osisi ndị na-adịghị anya metụtara (fungal leaf spot). Oge kedu gịnị ka ekwere na e mechiiri osisi niile dị ka ha niile wara obere ngwa-nkụ dị na mpaghara jupụtakwa obodo ebe na-ezughị oke (air cannot circulate freely)?

instruction: Kedu ogo mmalite akpụ (seed rate per hectare) iji tinye osisi ahụ (cowpea varieties) akpọrọ okwu maka ubi njikwa ụwa maka na Naijiria?
response: N'ebe mmepụta iji gịnị akuku ọka ka mgbidi pụtara ọhụrụ ubi na nkwado Nigeria n'ọhịa ọwụwa (determinate cowpea varieties), ọnụ ọgụgụ mgba ngwọta mkpụrụ njikọ (standard seed rate) maka ngagharị abụọ ruo iri abụọ (20 to 25 kg per hectare), ka ụkpụrụ ijide ịgbakwunye 250,000 ruo 300,000 maka akuku kwa hekta nyekwara mita n'etiti obere maka ewe mmalite 50 cm n'ọkwa ma ọ bụ obere.
